title: Land plot system
description: Cluster health, golden signals, replication lag, shard distribution, business metrics, resources and logs.

panels.title: Targets up
panels.description: up of every Prometheus target: the Go services, RabbitMQ, postgres-exporter and the stack. ServiceDown fires on 0 or on a missing Go service.

panels.title: Service health (/health)
panels.description: What /health of each Go service answers. ServiceUnhealthy fires on 0; autoheal restarts a container that stays unhealthy.

panels.title: Dependency checks
panels.description: Health of the dependencies: PostgreSQL as seen by postgres-exporter and by each service that reads its outbox and statistics on every scrape.

panels.title: PostgreSQL connections
panels.description: Open connections per database.

panels.title: RabbitMQ
panels.description: Connections, consumers and messages of the broker.

panels.title: Active alerts
panels.description: Alerts firing in Prometheus right now; empty when everything is fine.

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99 by service
panels.description: Health checks left out. The red line is the HighLatencyP99 threshold (1 s).

panels.title: Requests per second by service
panels.description: Requests per second over 5 minutes, health checks left out.

panels.title: Error rate (share of 5xx) by service
panels.description: The red line is the HighErrorRate threshold (5 %).

panels.title: Latency anomaly: p95 against the baseline
panels.description: LatencyAnomaly fires when p95 rises above the mean + 3σ of the previous hour and above 100 ms (red line).

panels.title: Gateway latency p99 by route
panels.description: Routes of the gateway; the route filter applies.

panels.title: Gateway → upstream p99
panels.description: Time of the proxied call from the gateway to each service.

panels.title: Gateway rejections (401 / 403 / 429)
panels.description: Responses with 401, 403 or 429, produced by the gateway or by a service.

panels.title: Latency p99 by route (selected services)
panels.description: Use the service and route variables to narrow it down.

panels.title: Requests per second by route (selected services)
Outbox: oldest pending row
panels.description: Age of the oldest event not yet confirmed by RabbitMQ. The red line is the ReplicationLagHigh threshold (30 s).

panels.title: Outbox: pending and failed rows
panels.description: Rows waiting for the broker, and rows abandoned after the maximum attempts.

panels.title: Outbox: published and failed per second
Queue messages
panels.description: Messages waiting in each queue and the linear forecast 15 minutes ahead. The red line is the QueueBacklog and BacklogPredicted threshold (100).

panels.title: Message age at processing (p95)
panels.description: Time from writing the event to the outbox until a consumer processed it.

panels.title: Messages processed per second
panels.description: ack, retry (requeued) or reject (dead-lettered).

panels.title: Share of requests by service
panels.description: Requests over the selected time range, health checks left out.

panels.title: Share of 5xx by service
panels.description: Empty when no request failed in the selected range.

panels.title: Requests per second by replica
panels.description: How the traffic of each service is spread over its replicas.

panels.title: Sagas
panels.description: Sagas finished in the last 10 minutes. The red line is the SagaCompensationsSpike threshold (5).

panels.title: External dependencies: share of failed calls
panels.description: Calls of report-service that ended with 5xx, an error or a timeout. The red line is the ExternalDependencyDown threshold (50 %).

panels.title: Conversions over the last hour
panels.description: Recording rules over the last hour; no data without previews or saved plots.

panels.title: Calls to other services: p95
panels.description: report-service to land-plot-service and to the Open-Meteo APIs.

panels.title: CPU of the Go services
panels.description: process_cpu_seconds_total of each Go service.

panels.title: Memory of the Go services
panels.description: Resident memory of each Go service.

panels.title: Logs of the selected services
panels.description: Filter by the service variable and by trace_id (empty shows every line). A trace_id in a line opens the trace in Jaeger.

panels.title: Log lines per service and level
